description: Git-based hosting for models, datasets and Spaces (demo apps), with cards, revisions, gating and access tokens.
A repository's README with YAML metadata (license, base_model, datasets, language) and prose on use, training, evaluation and limits. Written by the publisher.
The same for data: sources, collection, consent, personal data, license and known biases.
A commit hash of a Hub repository. Pinning it makes the evaluated and the deployed model the same artifact.
A repository that requires accepting terms before download; access goes through an account token.
Card metadata linking a fine-tune, adapter, merge or quantization to its origin. Follow it for license and provenance.
Hugging Face libraries for model loading and generation, data loading, parameter-efficient fine-tuning, and post-training (SFT, DPO, GRPO).
Hugging Face's small agent library; its CodeAgent writes actions as Python code run in a sandbox, alongside a JSON tool-calling agent.
OSI's definition (1.0, October 2024): freedoms to use, study, modify and share, with weights, code and detailed training-data information. Most open models are open weights only.
